rendered_html: 📔 Regulatory Bulletin — 19 October 2026 (Daily) Executive Summary • 🟡 HKSCC has set a conditional target to move Hong Kong cash-market settlement from T+2 to T+1 in the second half of 2028; the target remains subject to market readiness and regulatory approval. • Clearing Participants should start assessing post-trade operations, funding and stock availability, client cut-offs, customer documents, and exception controls; banks supporting affected securities activity may face indirect dependencies. Hong Kong 🟡 Implementation of T+1 Settlement Cycle for Hong Kong Cash Market 🇭🇰 Item ID: item-20261016-daily-exploratory-search-499152c0a0 ⏰ Deadline: Second half of 2028 (target implementation; subject to market readiness and regulatory approval) Products: Securities investment, custody, settlement HKSCC states that, subject to market readiness and regulatory approval, Hong Kong cash-market settlement will move from T+2 to T+1 in the second half of 2028. The circular is addressed to HKSCC Clearing Participants and says the shorter cycle means many post-trade activities must be completed on T-day. HKSCC expects Clearing Participants to assess systems and operations, liquidity, cash funding and stock availability, client cut-offs and communications, customer documents, and exception-management controls. Banks acting as brokers, custodians or settlement agents may be affected through post-trade, liquidity, customer-service, data and vendor dependencies; the circular does not establish an HKMA requirement or a fixed commencement date. Source: Implementation of T+1 Settlement Cycle for Hong Kong Cash Market Mainland/GBA _No validated current-run items._ SG/UK/GLOBAL Benchmark Comparable overseas developments and commercial/control benchmarks. They do not establish Hong Kong requirements. _No validated current-run items._ Watch List • Monitor HKSCC’s T+1 Web Corner for updated processing timetables, technical information and participant-webinar details.
